meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. The sitting of c=8 is a long ODE. This window is short. The field did not follow.

lemmas.name: B32_window_readable
lemmas.statement: window rates, missed viscous room, and sketch-grows / field-falls are readable together
lemmas.why: j: 2 → 2.51. Room is j=5 at T=0.375. This window is 0.064. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B32a_window_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: matching the c=8 sketch to this NS window closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: The sketch grew. The field fell. A short window is not the sitting of B11c.

lemmas.name: B32b_short_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: cashing B11c on T=0.064 is a continuation argument for classical X
lemmas.why: The sitting is a long ODE. This box is short. Time to the room is 0.375. Do not cash a later save.

lemmas.name: B32c_growing_not_ns
lemmas.statement: a typed ODE that climbs while the packet falls is still an NS a priori
lemmas.why: Prescribed Δj = 0.512. NS Δj_bar ≈ −0.015. Do not sit the sketch as the packet.

lemmas.name: B32d_window_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: matching the sketch on this window is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: A short-window sign of Ẋ is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. A growing sketch against a falling packet is not the max criterion.

lemmas.name: B32e_finer_leftover
lemmas.why: Scored as B22e / B33. A bigger FFT is not continuation. Finer DNS is not an a priori (B23e). Leftover close is not an a priori (B34e). Regularity leftover is not an a priori (B35e). Regularity stays open. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B32f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring the climb sketch as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. The window is a knob on the check. No Q1. No ε. Do not type c=8 into the equation.
